text: AGROTHYMON, from _works_, _stresses_ and _hetype._ A few of wart deferled by Celtics au hard, rough, with a narrow bala and broad top; the top is of the colon: d thyres, it early lipits and bleeds. This tumour is all called tissue.

ACROTHYMION, from ακρος, extreme, and θυμος, thyme. A fort of wart deferibed by Celfus as hard, rough, with a narrow bafis and broad top ; the top is of the colour of thyme, it eafily fplits and bleeds. This tumour is alfo called thymus.
